content: {"phoneNote":"First screen works (address, headline, intro, photo peeking in), but the hours section stacks five identical full-width bars that eat a whole screen, and the services list is sparse text with large empty gaps.","desktopNote":"Hero is strong, but below it the page thins out: five identical hours bars, empty right halves in 'Pridite po dogovoru' and 'Kdo pride k meni', and three competing booking CTAs across header, hero and mid-page.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Collapse the hours into one line ('Pon–pet 7.00–20.00, samo po naročilu') or a compact table; five identical bars add height without information.","Fill the empty right half of 'Pridite po dogovoru' and 'Kdo pride k meni' on desktop with a second practice photo or give services short descriptions.","Keep one booking CTA per screen (drop 'Izberite termin' or the header button) and merge the repeated phone/address blocks into one contact block."],"blockers":[]}
